title: ElicitationQuestion
description: Standalone, reusable JSON Schema for a single ask-user clarification question. Matches ai-for-china-legal/shared/inkstatute-integration/ASK-USER-PROTOCOL.md: id, question, allow_multiple (default false), options (label/value). Absence of the options array implies a free-text question.

question.description: Question text presented to the user.

allow_multiple.description: false = single-select, true = multi-select. Per-question; do not force multi globally.

options.description: Choice options. Each item has label (display text) and value (machine value). Absence of this array implies a free-text question.
